primary_outcome: Correct collected report selection, bounded scope, availability or performance verdict, separate complete failed and unknown check sets, and numeric measurements.
failure_rule: Retain all assignments; missing, malformed, uncollected and failed trials score zero. Known-cost provider-classified invalid, ambiguous or incomplete replies fail that trial without retry; proceed to the next assignment. Unknown cost, identity mismatch, fatal account/configuration or unclassified provider failures, host failures and exhausted cost accounting stop that model; unattempted assignments remain separate.
scope: Development calibration or pilot on reviewed case instances of one API service and six fixed model snapshots. EAL includes executable checking and MCP; JSON and prose use direct tools without EAL evaluation or MCP. plain_validator adds ordinary deterministic checking to the explicit prose arm. Transports are separate. No confirmatory efficacy claim or population inference.
